label: rem:incompleteness-horizon-nontriviality
title: Arithmetic non-triviality condition on the resolution system
html:
Remark. Arithmetic non-triviality condition on the resolution system

The hypothesis of prop:incompleteness-implies-horizon carries an implicit arithmetic non-triviality condition: the surjectivity of e and the domain \mathbb{N} of \mathrm{eval} require \mathbb{N} to embed into the system. Without this condition the diagonal argument is vacuous — a trivial category lacks self-referential capacity, rendering incompleteness inapplicable.
